applicability.avoid_when: completion is already evidenced or the user has not authorized the proactive interruption timing
applicability.when: user explicitly requests a single future reminder conditioned on whether preparation remains incomplete

method_path: Represent the user-requested future check as a waiting-time Task instead of sending repeated reminders.
At the due Wake, inspect the latest durable world evidence before deciding whether interruption is still needed.
If the latest evidence still shows incomplete preparation and no newer completion evidence exists, send one evidence-bounded reminder that distinguishes known state from uncertainty.
After delivery, stop repeated prompting and wait for new user/world evidence; terminalize the reminder Task once completion evidence arrives.
arguments.result_summary: The one Sunday reminder matched the user’s requested timing and latest incomplete preparation evidence. The user explicitly said the reminder came at the right time, then stated they would act; later photo and user evidence confirmed the two preparation actions were completed. This experience does not claim the next-day fire inspection passed; that outcome is still unknown.
